title: 3rd Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/2/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's appointment of a Chairperson of the Privatization and Corporatization Board, made under Article 9(a) and (b) of the Privatization, Corporatization, Monitoring and Evaluation of State Businesses Act (Law No. 3/2013), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review before Parliament gives its consent.

From the Speaker's desk: the President has returned the Human Organ Transplantation Bill, which Parliament passed and sent for ratification, for reconsideration under Article 91(a) of the Constitution.
Preliminary debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem noting that councillors' pay needs a positive change and seeking members' views on it.
Preliminary debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the Personal Data Protection Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru West MP Ali Ibrahim.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to send a Privatization Board chair appointment to committee, take up the President's return of the Organ Transplantation Bill, and debate a councillors' pay resolution plus the Maldives 2.0 and Data Protection bills.
